method: Full-stream decode plus inspection of 24 time-labelled timeline frames and four event-neighbour frames from this independent recording. Browser playback host unavailable.
observations: The robot visibly grasps at the source and carries the tool past the occupied chair to the opposite desk.
The second original action contains chair-proximity exposure from 36.8 s, with minimum measured chassis clearance 0.3569 m. No injury is shown.
The third action fails its measured chair-location precondition after navigation reached the desk; the final scene retains the tool and no placement is shown.
The unchanged six-action plan has three later actions which were not executed; they must remain visible as unexecuted on the website.
limitations: The payload is small in the room-wide camera; contact/state evidence accompanies the recording.
This review uses decoded frame samples, not continuous browser playback.
